Clause C5 - other (development_control): Development must protect views to and from public open spaces.

Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 2 14 Unique Environmental Features

Clause 2.14.2 - other (development_control): Development adjoining public open space must be set back from open space and be of a height and scale appropriate to the unique environmental qualities of the area.

Clause 2.14.5 - other (development_control): Development within the scenic protection area must be:
i. Designed and located to minimise potential adverse environmenta impact. This is particularly important where properties are within a foreshore area or where the land is flood affected (see maps in Section 2.22 – Flood Management);
ii. Of a scale compatible with the character, landscape and scenic qualities of the area;
iii. Of minimal visual impact when viewed from any adjoining public open space; and
iv. Where adjoining public open space provides a visual transition between open space and avoids abutting public open space with high, blank or solid fences (such as timber paling fences without openings or corrugated fencing).

Clause 2.14.5 - other (development_control): Sandstone cliffs, outcrops and overhangs must be retained in situ and integrated into the design of new development.

Clause 2.14.5 - other (environmental_protection): Any plantings are to enhance fauna habitat and to be local species endemic to the area.

original_text:
Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 2 17 Water Sensitive Urban Design

Clause 2.17 - other (development_control): The WSUD provisions within this chapter apply to new development and redevelopment within the area and aim to:  • Reduce potable water use; and Treat stormwater so that the area reaches the relevant stormwater quality targets for stormwater reuse and/or stormwater entering receiving waters.

Clause 2.17.2 - other (development_control): Specific developments are required to meet water conservation and stormwater quality targets that have been established for land where this DCP applies.

Clause 2.17.3 - other (development_control): All residential buildings are to demonstrate compliance with State Environmental Planning Policy - Building Sustainability Index (BASIX), as required.

Clause 2.17.3 - other (development_control): All buildings not covered by the State Environmental Planning Policy - BASIX: i. that are installing any water use fittings must meet minimum standards defined by the Water Efficiency Labelling and Standards (WELS) Scheme. Minimum WELS ratings are 4 star dual-flush toilets, 3 star showerheads, 4 star taps (for all taps other than bath

Clause 2.17.3 - other (development_control): are to install rainwater tanks to meet all non-potable demands, including outdoor use, toilets, and laundry (for child care centres, this water is to be used for irrigation and toilet flushing only).

Clause 2.17.3 - other (development_control): are to incorporate passive cooling methods that rely on improved natural ventilation to supplement or preclude mechanical cooling (refer Section 2.16.5.6).

Clause 2.17.3 - other (development_control): where cooling towers are used, they are:

a. to be connected to a conductivity meter to ensure optimum circulation before discharge.

Clause 2.17.3 - other (development_control): to include a water meter connected to a building energy and water metering system to monitor water usage.

Clause 2.17.3 - other (development_control): to employ alternative water sources for cooling towers.

Clause 2.17.3 - other (development_control): Water use within common open space (for uses such as irrigation and water features) should be supplied from sources other than potable mains water (e.g. stormwater, greywater or wastewater) to meet $80 \%$ of the water use demand.

Clause 2.17.4 - other (environmental_protection): For all development types identified in Table 1, stormwater quality load reduction controls are:

i. $90 \%$ reduction in the post development mean annual load of Gross Pollutants (greater than 5mm).

Clause 2.17.4 - other (environmental_protection): $8 5 \%$ reduction in the post development mean annual load of Total Suspended Solids (TSS).

Clause 2.17.4 - other (environmental_protection): $60 \%$ reduction in the post development mean annual load of Total Phosphorus (TP).

original_text:
Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 2 25 Stormwater management

Clause # 2.25 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): The flow of stormwater from developments needs to be managed so as to negate or reduce to an acceptable frequency the possibility of flooding buildings and/or the danger to life at any location, through the storage of stormwater where appropriate in developments and the control of major development drainage systems.

Clause # 2.25.1 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): To protect the urban environment from the effects of otherwise uncontrolled surface stormwater flows resulting from infrequent (and lesser) storm events.

Clause # 2.25.1 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): To minimise or negate disruption and/or danger to both pedestrian and vehicular traffic that may be caused by otherwise uncontrolled surface stormwater flows resulting from frequent storm events.

Clause # 2.25.1 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): To protect the quality of receiving waters, adjacent and downstream land-use and the rights of adjacent and downstream landowners.

Clause # 2.25.2 - other (development_control): On Site Detention	Yes (3, 6)

Clause # 2.25.2 - other (development_control): On Site Retention	Yes (3,8)

Clause # 2.25.2 - other (development_control): Gravity Pipe System Required	Yes (4)

Clause # 2.25.2 - other (development_control): Pump System Permitted	No (4)

Clause # 2.25.2 - other (development_control): Drainage Easement over downstream property (2)

Clause # 2.25.2 - other (development_control): Qualified Engineer required to prepare drainage design	Yes (3, 6)

Clause # 2.25.2 - other (environmental_protection): Sediment Control Plan Required	Yes (1)

Clause # 2.25.2 - other (development_control): Positive Covenant Required (i.e. Section88E (3) Instrument)	No (5)
